# Synergy Salon

> Master-certified hair colour and cut salon in Valrico, Florida, serving
> Valrico, Brandon, Lithia, FishHawk and Bloomingdale since 2004.

Synergy Salon is an independent salon at 3212 Lithia Pinecrest Rd, Suite 101,
Valrico, FL 33594. Owner Dina Lara has been a licensed cosmetologist since 1981
and trained at Redken's 5th Avenue salon in Manhattan and Keune's School of
Color in Amsterdam. Appointments are booked online or by phone on 813.654.2055.
Service is available in English and Spanish.

## Services
- Colour: balayage, highlights and foils, corrective colour for box dye or
  another salon's mistake
- Treatments: keratin and Brazilian Blowout smoothing, Olaplex and K18 bond
  repair, deep conditioning, AI scalp analysis
- Cuts: women, men, teens and children
- Styling: blowouts, updos and special-event styling, extensions by consultation

## Guarantee
Love it, or you don't pay. If a guest is not happy with their hair, the salon
adjusts it or refunds the service.

## Hours
Monday, Tuesday, Saturday 9am-3pm. Wednesday, Thursday 9am-7pm.
Friday 9am-6pm. Closed Sunday. Eastern Time.
